items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured valve. One valve at the reference rate is €52 gross.
Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover the connection hose renewed with the valve. One hose at the reference rate is €27 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover labour for the fitting repair. The three invoiced hours at about €98.33 gross per hour total €295.

Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 expressly cover consumables actually used in the fitting repair, as distinct from the contractor's own equipment under 3.6(c). The single materials allowance is estimated at €15 gross if substantiated.
Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.11 cover one attendance for the insured repair. With no stated reduction, one attendance is estimated at €80 gross using the full-cover reference.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to locate the escape, and 3.6 exempts it from the tools exclusion. One use is estimated at €65 gross, below the €2,500 event limit.
Section 7.1.11 excludes a second attendance by the same undertaking unless agreed in advance, and no approval is stated. If approved, one visit would be about €80 gross.

items.description: Removal of loose and spalled plaster
items.rationale: The facade frost endorsement activates 2.6.2, which covers stripping failed material from the damaged elevation. Two invoiced units at an estimated €95 gross each total €190.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the frost-damaged area. One invoiced lot is estimated at €180 gross.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover re-forming the damaged substrate, distinct from supplying the base plaster. One invoiced lot is estimated at €220 gross.
Section 2.6.2 expressly covers priming the repaired frost-damaged area. One invoiced lot is estimated at €90 gross.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover drying when necessary before reinstatement of the affected substrate. One drying charge is estimated at €120 gross if that need is substantiated.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover the coats required by the like-for-like finish system on the damaged elevation. The single invoiced four-coat lot is estimated at €320 gross.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour on the damaged elevation; the rear repaint is billed separately. Five invoiced hours at €75 gross per hour total €375.

Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.8 cover necessary scaffolding, with no apportionment because it served only the frost-damaged elevation. One two-storey scaffold hire across roughly eight metres, including erection and dismantling, is estimated at €950 gross.
Sections 2.6.3(a), 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting a separate, undamaged elevation, even for appearance matching. One repaint lump sum would otherwise be about €850 gross.
Sections 2.6.2 and 5.2.1 cover disposal of debris from the insured facade repair. One collection and disposal charge for a few rubble sacks is estimated at €85 gross.
Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude a separate administrative fee because it prices no repair work. A nominal gross estimate for one such fee is €25.
Sections 3.6(a) and 7.1.12 expressly exclude crew catering even when the principal work is insured. Three servings at a nominal €15 gross each total €45.
